vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v1
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: an_array_tag_carries_its_elements
vectors.why: `OfflineLogDirs` is tag 0, an array of uuid. Its payload is a whole compact array — length prefix and elements — inside one tagged entry, so the entry's declared size covers all of it.
